# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r}
library("grid")
library("xdvir")
library("upxdvir")
options(warn = 2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
```

## Draw UpTeX Content

```{r, fig.align = "center"}
grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
grid.segments(
    c(0, .5, .25, .75),
    c(.5, 0, 0, 0),
    c(1, .5, .25, .75),
    c(.5, 1, 1, 1),
    gp = gpar(lty = 3, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
)
grid.latex("ページレイアウトのABCD設定とし",
    documentClass = "utarticle"
)
grid.latex("ページレイアウトの設定とし",
    vjust = 1, x = .25,
    documentClass = "utarticle"
)
grid.uplatex("ページレイアウトの設定とし",
    vjust = 0, x = .75,
    documentClass = "utarticle"
)
```
